title: Blog Header
description: The top of a blog index, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Chip and Skeleton primitives: a kicker, a serif title and a sentence of introduction over a row of category chips, each a link to its category with the current one filled, with its own loading, empty and error renders for the categories; responds to its container (@container) — a larger description at @sm, a larger title and more room between the chips at @md, and more room around the header at @lg.
